components.name: Text field
components.description: Readable prose inside square paper fields.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:7px;color:var(--ink,#243b2e);font:12px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-field input{font:inherit;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--surface,#fff8e8);color:var(--ink,#243b2e);border:1px solid var(--green,#426348);border-radius:0}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:var(--ink,#243b2e)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#b63c31)}

components.name: Navigation item
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:3px;background:var(--sidebar,#e7ecd8);padding:10px}.ds-nav button{font:400 13px/1.5 Silkscreen,monospace;text-align:left;padding:12px 14px;min-height:43px;color:var(--muted,#53644f);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0;background:none}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#dce5cc;color:var(--ink,#243b2e)}.ds-nav [aria-current=page]{background:var(--accent-pale,#f2dfc3);color:var(--accent,#b63c31);border-color:var(--ink,#243b2e);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 var(--accent,#b63c31)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#b63c31);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Speech cloud
components.description: Layered dialogue with the pet’s stepped speech tail.
components.html: What would you like to do?
components.css: .ds-cloud{position:relative;margin:8px 10px 20px;padding:12px;border:3px solid #203d2d;border-radius:0;background:#fff5d9;color:#203d2d;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #faf0d6,inset 0 0 0 4px #d4c9a5,0 4px 12px #152b2122}.ds-cloud p{font:14px/1.65 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-cloud button{font:10px/1.5 Silkscreen,sans-serif;border:0;border-radius:0;background:#a83e29;color:#fff5d9;padding:6px 7px;min-height:30px}.ds-cloud button:hover{background:#8d2e1d}.ds-cloud button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a83e29;outline-offset:3px}.ds-cloud i{position:absolute;bottom:-12px;left:calc(50% - 9px);width:18px;height:12px;background:#fff5d9;border:3px solid #203d2d;border-top:0}.ds-cloud i:after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-6px;left:3px;width:6px;height:6px;background:#203d2d}

components.name: Pet selector
components.description: Idle pet reveals three tool slots underneath on hover or keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-pet-actions{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:0}.ds-pet-focus{border:0;background:transparent;color:#203d2d;font:12px/1.5 Silkscreen,sans-serif;padding:20px}.ds-selector{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:3px;border:2px solid #203d2d;background:#fff5d9;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(4px);transition:opacity 120ms ease-out,transform 120ms ease-out,visibility 120ms}.ds-pet-actions:has(.ds-pet-focus:hover) .ds-selector,.ds-selector:hover,.ds-pet-actions:has(:focus-visible) .ds-selector{opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;transform:none}.ds-selector button{font:7px/1.3 Silkscreen,sans-serif;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#203d2d;height:33px;padding:2px 6px;transform-origin:bottom center;transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background-color 100ms ease-out,color 100ms ease-out}.ds-selector button:hover,.ds-selector button:focus-visible{background:#a83e29;color:#fff5d9;transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.1)}.ds-selector button:hover+button,.ds-selector button:has(+button:hover){transform:translateY(-1px) scale(1.03)}.ds-pet-actions button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a83e29;outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-selector,.ds-selector button,.ds-selector button:hover,.ds-selector button:focus-visible,.ds-selector button:hover+button,.ds-selector button:has(+button:hover){transition:none;transform:none}}

narrative.northStar: A calm workspace for a playful little companion.
narrative.overview:
Pace brings the play; the interface makes room for the task. The user’s GBA/8-bit direction spans the desktop companion, speech clouds, campsite introduction and supporting workspace. Cream paper, forest outlines, brick-red selections and the original yellow cheetah share one world.

Self-hosted pixel lettering and square controls carry the game character. Editable prose, explanations and transcripts use readable platform sans. The companion’s authored poses remain the focal art; the workspace supports real setup, settings and longer records.
keyCharacteristics: One pixel world across the app
Cream paper, forest frames and brick-red actions
Readable long prose beside pixel controls
Original sprite identity and calibrated new poses

rules.name: The One World Rule
rules.body: Carry the pixel vocabulary through the companion and workspace; the campsite is an expression of the shared world, not its boundary.

rules.name: The Readable Prose Rule
rules.body: Use Silkscreen for short display and control text; keep editable text, explanations and transcripts in platform sans.

rules.name: The Honest State Rule
rules.body: A pose, progress indicator or ready label must follow the actual operation; a preview never implies an insertion happened.

dos: Do preserve the original Pace artwork, colors and authored timing.
Do use square controls, forest boundaries and brick-red selections throughout the app.
Do keep generated prose scrollable, selectable and reviewable.
Do preserve keyboard focus, accessible names and reduced-motion behavior.
Do show real model, permission, recording and insertion states.
donts: Don’t put pixel lettering in long editable prose or transcripts.
Don’t fabricate replies, transcripts, download completion or capture success.
Don’t replace the companion’s explicit cursor continuation with a primary rewrite workbench.
Don’t promise universal screen-capture exclusion or continuous background autocomplete.
